messages:
jess: We're seeing a sudden cluster of 502/504s and timeouts hitting hosted inference in eu-west-1 starting ~3067123400. Customer reports and PagerDuty alerts coming in. High error rate on /v1/generate and /v1/chat.

sam: Confirmed. Metrics: 5xx rate jumped from 0.2% -> 12% in last 3m. Latency P95 shot to 2.4s then timeouts.

maria: Observed long tail on gateway connections. K8s node logs show repeated upstream reset from runtime pods.

opsbot: Incident created: THUNDER-5XX-EUW (auto). War room channel: #warroom-thunder-5xx.

support-bot: Multiple customer escalations: acct-redacted@example.com, acct-2432. Tickets opened.

jess: Quick repro (curl) shows gateway 502:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
* Connection state changed (MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS updated)!
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream error: connection reset"}
```

kevin: Looking at runtime telemetry: sudden spike in KV cache miss rate and memory pressure on model-serving pods. A subset of nodes hitting OOM-kill before request completes.

arjun: Any recent config or rollout? Canary for kernel optimizer went live 1h ago.

maria: Yes, canary rollout for dynamic batching kernels (opt-rt-2) at 30% started ~1h. Correlation looks strong with the start time.

sam: Mitigation idea: rollback opt-rt-2 on hosted runtime pool and drain affected nodes, switch routing to fallback model variant (quantized v2) and apply circuit-breaker to reduce concurrency per node.

jess: Action: kevin to trigger immediate rollback and drain. sam to update routing policy to failover. maria to scale up warm standby pool. arjun to hold canary paused and collect logs.

kevin: Rolling back canary now (kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-runtime-canary --namespace=hosted). Draining nodes: cordon + drain on nodes with high OOM count.

arjun: Paused canary on controller. Collecting kernel logs and heap dumps to S3: s3://rdw-infra-logs/thunder-3067123456/.

support-bot: Notifying impacted customers with draft template.

sam: After rollback latency down to baseline within ~8m. 5xx rate falling to 0.6%. Still monitoring for residual errors.

jess: Good. Immediate customer-facing mitigation completed. Next: short postmortem and action items.

maria: Proposed postmortem items:
- root cause: canary kernel optimization increases memory usage/path edge-case leading to KV cache contention and OOMs on some workloads.
- fix: add OOM guardrails to kernel, memory caps per pod, improved canary throttling.
- operational: add alert for KV miss + OOM correlation, increase warm standby for peak windows, add auto-fallback routing policy when canary error rate > 1%.

arjun: I'll own kernel fixes (ETA 3d). kevin: infra changes for memory caps and drain playbook (ETA 1d). sam: routing fallback and circuit-breaker tuning (ETA 2d). jess: coordinate customer comms and postmortem writeup (ETA 2d).

support-bot: Created follow-up tickets: INFRA-592 (drain playbook), RUNTIME-1103 (kernel OOM guard), ROUTE-778 (fallback policy), PM-3067 (postmortem).

jess: Interim runbook note: if similar thundering 5xx observed -- 1) pause new canaries, 2) roll back suspect optimizer, 3) cordon/drain affected nodes, 4) switch routing to fallback model variant, 5) notify customers. Add to runbooks/hosted/responses.

kevin: Postmortem sync scheduled in 48h. I'll attach node heap dumps and kube events.

sam: Also recommend adding a synthetic test hitting long-context paths to catch KV/heap regressions in canary.

jess: Thanks all. Closing war room when last 5xx sustained <0.5% for 30m. Current status: monitoring, degraded -> stabilizing. :white_check_mark:
